title: I-Lang Dictionary: the complete vocabulary of the I-Lang protocol
description: The complete reference vocabulary for I-Lang v5.0: 88 verbs in 9 categories, 13 Greek aliases, 29 core modifiers plus the 20-key media profile, 25 entities (17 addressable and 8 role) and 32 declarations, including the v5.0 judgment vocabulary and the v4.1 media profile for image, video and audio. The repository ships the human-readable dictionary and a CSV table of the same entries for machine use.
